name: CV-Bench-3D-gt3dloc-v3
description: A dataset for visual 3D localization / camera pose estimation that provides ground-truth 3D locations for images. It is intended to evaluate algorithms that recover camera position and orientation (relocalization) in complex scenes. Evaluation focuses on geometric pose accuracy under real-world variations.
evaluation_method: Median translation and rotation error; percentage of queries within predefined translation/rotation thresholds
general_score_metric: Median translation error (meters) and rotation error (degrees); % within threshold
reputation: Available on Hugging Face and useful for visual localization research; niche adoption within the 3D/robotics community rather than broad benchmark status.
